note: 240 products reviewed. The recommended actions are worth $1.7M of annual gross margin. 111 items carry a price increase worth $1.7M, concentrated where the item is under the market or has gone unmanaged while its input cost moved. 2 items are priced far enough above the market, on demand elastic enough, that coming back toward it buys more volume than it costs -- $2k. 16 items cannot be priced at all until costing maintains a standard cost for them. 2 small items lose money at any price the market will bear and should be exited unless they hold a listing.
